name: state
meaning: TelescopeState: 0 viewing, 1 just started (mask drawn, input next frame), 2 idle

name: focal
meaning: camera focal passed to Camera_StartScripted = focal[mode]

name: eye
meaning: camera eye = pos + (0,-0xB4,0) + camDist along the view direction

name: yawOffset
meaning: current horizontal offset; starts at initHorAngle; clamped to ±maxHorAngle (may overshoot by one step)

name: pitchOffset
meaning: current vertical offset; starts at ±initVertAngle (negated in reverse); clamped to ±maxVertAngle

name: camDistByMode
meaning: [0] CAMDISTNORMAL, [1] CAMDISTREVERSE; eye distance along the view direction

name: mode
meaning: 0 normal, 1 reverse; chosen by msg 2 from the box that holds the Wolf; also passed to Hud_DrawTelescopeMask

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: Wolf msg 0xE reply at start; msg 0xF sent on exit; cleared when another object takes the freeze (msg 0xE to the telescope)
